ruio.name: ruio
ruio.description: A lightweight developer tool to visualize and debug React component hierarchy.

flappy-js.name: flappy-js
flappy-js.description: Modeled after the original Flappy Bird game with an added twist of being written in 30 lines.

dead-mart.name: dead-mart
dead-mart.description: Open source, recreation of a video game shop UI (inspired by Valve's in-game design). Written with vanilla CSS.

gbot.name: gbot
gbot.description: An automated crypto trading bot built for Unix-based systems, activated via the command line. It analyzes market trends to execute winning trades in real-time without storing personal data.

meme-generator.name: meme-generator
meme-generator.description: A simple meme generator where users can input text and an image URL to create custom memes. Built with HTML5 Canvas and forms. My first project!

calculator.name: calculator
calculator.description: A functional, 1:1 recreation of a calculator using React and vanilla CSS, showcasing how developers can create clean, accurate interfaces without relying on external styling libraries/frameworks.
